title: AAP Delegation Assertion claim set (AAP-SPEC section 5.3)
description: Claims of the DA: the CGT claim set plus the RFC 8693 delegation members. `sub` is the delegatee, `act.sub` the delegating agent (nesting `act` expresses a chain, innermost first, per RFC 8693 section 4.1), `max_depth` bounds further delegation, `delegator_atx` embeds the delegator's ATX hash for the audit trail (AAP-SPEC section 5.2). The delegatee scope MUST be a subset of the delegator's scope; subsetting is enforced by the minting broker and re-checked by verifiers — the schema pins presence and form, not the subset relation. Self-contained: duplicates the CGT members rather than $ref-ing them so verification never requires reference resolution.

max_depth.description: Remaining delegation depth; 0 is a terminal delegation (AAP-SPEC 0.5 section 5.3). MUST NOT exceed the delegator's matching peer_agent subDelegationDepth (section 5.4; a verifier check).

fga_constraints.description: DEPRECATED in AAP-SPEC 0.5; replacedBy `authorization_details`. Optional-to-ignore. No implementation minted it as of 2026-09-08.

authorizationDetails.description: RFC 9396 authorization_details typed by the AAP-SPEC section 4.4.1 registry; the wire value of `type` is the registry URI `https://specs.opena2a.org/aap/types/<name>`. In a DA every entry MUST be narrower than or equal to a delegator entry of the same type and no entry may lack a parent (section 5.4); the schema pins presence and form, the attenuation relation is a verifier check. Duplicated from cgt-claims-v1 so the DA schema stays self-contained.
